latestTerminalSummary:
No new actionable defect found. **Both R1 P2 witness findings are closed in source; runtime qualification remains open.**

Reviewed frozen `c3b1ae95fbf8939258e1038ee8a94d5f3739ba28`, directly atop `f1689d65064ce333e4277bc6a6adc866221644b2`: five files, 66 insertions/23 deletions.

- **P2-1 closed:** `TerminalObserved` captures the actual account’s complete stop into scalar storage. After owner teardown, the test compares it with `operation_stop`, including dimension, requested/remaining bytes and reason. Existing source-F and independently stopped-channel expectations remain precise. [Account capture and comparison](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-361487a2/rust/geometry/src/resource/gate_boundary_witnesses_tests.rs:112).
- **P2-2 closed:** injection records the actual requested `Layout::size()` after debit and before Global. The witness requires exact `max(previous_peak, previous_live + requested_bytes)`; pre-stopped work requires zero recorded Layout and unchanged Usage. [Exact peak assertion](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-361487a2/rust/geometry/src/resource/gate_boundary_witnesses_tests.rs:194).

Inspection supports unchanged common debit/refund handling, old pointer/value/capacity preservation, metadata/live/work/copy checks, source precedence, Weak/pool cleanup, independent real-old-block free-before-refund instrumentation, and strictly `cfg(test)` storage identity. Added atomics remain inline, per-gate and feature-only; injected attempts make no Global call and create no candidate block.

All five before/after hashes and blobs, frozen checksums, and the exact incremental diff verified. In-memory hunk checking against parent `06209aac5de57c68704084c4bbd3c42d6c59e43f` preserves its quota/`checked_add` changes.

**Next evidence required:** source-qualified execution on the assembled correction, plus the remaining feature/resolution/package, WASM and strict-Clippy checks. Job `420800fd` qualifies only `85a44`; it supplies no f168/c3 pass. Zeroed/shrink injection and full owner activation remain explicit residuals.

No builds, tests, jobs or edits performed.
